profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Qualcomm
profile.jobTitle: Senior Software Engineer, Machine Learning Group
profile.summary: Experienced Senior Software Engineer with a Bachelor of Science (B.S.) focused in Computer Science from University of California, San Diego.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Machine Learning Group
Software Engineer
positions.description:
+ Mentor newer members on the team
+ Complete SA work and lead implementation and integration efforts for entire features
+ Collaborate with System Engineers to determine feasibility of features and requirements
+ Learn and execute SAFe framework and ideology
+ Lead sprints as SAFe-Certified Scrum Master, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospective

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
+ Work on multi-language system based primarily on C++11 and Java
+ Integrate new APIs into software for increased performance efficiency
+ Develop efficient software architecture and design practices guided by supervising mentors
+ Manage and implement key features while considering future maintenance
+ Flash and perform integration testing on product hardware
+ Prioritize and fix defects in a timely manner, occasionally assisting project QA
+ Collaborate with international teams to debug and integration test software
+ Quickly resolve showstopper defects for release candidates
+ Train and acquaint new hires with software and hardware
+ Support automation test framework developers using Python 3.5
+ Assist in integration of automation software into a Jenkins pipeline
+ Complete SA work and planning for features and integration of RTI Connext DDS Secure 6.0.1

positions.title: Software Intern
positions.description:
+ Debug failing unit tests
+ Optimize unit tests, helping reduce overall compile time in half
+ Remove dead code while completing tasks
+ Research and learn RTI DDS Connext in Java and in Modern C++ [11]
+ Replace hard-coded QoS policy framework with dynamic QoS profile loading from single XML file
+ Utilize the std library to minimize overhead and increase overall service efficiency
+ Develop builders and implement builders in reader/writer callbacks
+ Create new and/or modify existing unit tests to align services with new features and updates
+ Help maintain system software, fixing bugs when needed/possible
+ Flash hardware with latest firmware images via dd Unix command
+ Participate in scrums, providing input when deemed useful

positions.title: REU Programming/Research Assistant
positions.description:
+ Write scripts to calculate inferred RTTs and investigate traceroute and geolocation anomalies regarding IP paths
+ Debug various scripts used on Ark and AS Rank projects
+ Update existing Perl scripts responsible for generating an interactive Ark project map via GoogleMaps or MapBox APIs
+ Improve UI/UX for AS Rank project maps implemented by MVC framework

company.name: Center for Applied Internet Data Analysis (CAIDA)

positions.title: Engineering Instructor
positions.description:
+ Teach basic engineering fundamentals to children of grades 1 to 8
+ Use GUI-based IDEs to teach basic programming concepts and robotics
+ Lead teams of 3 to teach classes of up to 40 students
+ Develop professional communication styles to relate new concepts to beginner students, making lessons more accessible and relateable

positions.title: Shipping Department Laborer
positions.description:
+ Wrap and package items in sealed bags for storage and future shipments
+ Box products safely while using minimal bubble wrap
+ Set up, fill up, and wrap cardboard pallet containers
+ Conduct inventory checks
